verdict.rationale: ernd is a corporate card for AI vendor spend, so codified expense policies with auto-approval are a fair question for this kind of product. However, the evidence covers only rewards, partner perks and card signup. Nothing documents spend limits by category, role or context, policy rules, auto-approval, or exception routing to a human.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can codify our expense policy — limits by category, role, and context — so in-policy expenses auto-approve and only exceptions reach a human
